outcome_label: Mixed: at least one violation and at least one no-violation finding
outcome_raw: Violation of Art. 3;Violation of Art. 5-4;Violation of Art. 13;No violation of Art. 5-1;Not necessary to examine Art. 8;Non-pecuniary damage - finding of violation sufficient;Costs and expenses partial award - Convention proceedings

operative_provisions.text: Holds by twelve votes to seven that, in the event of the Secretary of State's decision to deport the first applicant to India being implemented, there would be a violation of Article 3 of the Convention (art. 3);
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 1]

operative_provisions.text: Holds by thirteen votes to six that there has been no violation of Article 5 para. 1 of the Convention (art. 5-1);
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 2]

operative_provisions.text: Holds unanimously that there has been a violation of Article 5 para. 4 of the Convention (art. 5-4);
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 3]

operative_provisions.text: Holds by seventeen votes to two that, having regard to its conclusion with regard to Article 3 (art. 3), it is not necessary to consider the applicants' complaint under Article 8 of the Convention (art. 8);
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 4]

operative_provisions.text: Holds unanimously that there has been a violation of Article 13 in conjunction with Article 3 of the Convention (art. 13+3);
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 5]

operative_provisions.text: Holds unanimously that the above findings of violation constitute sufficient just satisfaction as regards the claim for compensation for non-pecuniary damage;
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 6]

operative_provisions.text: Holds unanimously (a) that the respondent State is to pay the applicants, within three months, in respect of costs and expenses, £45,000 (forty-five thousand pounds sterling) less 21,141 (twenty-one thousand, one hundred and forty-one) French francs to be converted into pounds sterling at the rate applicable on the date of delivery of the present judgment; (b) that simple interest at an annual rate of 8% shall be payable from the expiry of the above-mentioned three months until settlement;
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 7]

operative_provisions.text: Dismisses unanimously the remainder of the claim for just satisfaction.
operative_provisions.cite: [Chahal v. the United Kingdom, Judgment, Operative provisions, para 8]

corpus.scope: UK cases only (plus the Convention and the Human Rights Act 1998)
